Distillate and reflux flows essentially zero/noise throughout; no reflux established
Column pressure drop stays ~0.6 mbar, indicating negligible vapour traffic
Reboiler heater at ~443-446 °C while T703 vessel only creeps 71.4→73.0 °C
Slow ~10 min cyclic swings of column heaters with no net progress

args.missing_evidence: A distillate/reflux flow above noise and rising top temperatures (T711/T712/T705), plus a composition sample, would show boil-up and separation actually started; heater setpoint/control log would distinguish control issue from a thermal/process fault.
